rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Vector equation and Cartesian equation are completely unrelated' ✅ They represent the same line; the vector form is r = a + tb, while the Cartesian form is (x-x₁)/a = (y-y₁)/b = (z-z₁)/c.  ·  ❌ 'A line in space is defined by only one point' ✅ A line in space requires *two* points OR *one point and a direction vector* to be uniquely defined.
